newsitem.title: FRANCE: French government repeats 1997 budget due Sept 18.
newsitem.headline: French government repeats 1997 budget due Sept 18.

text.p: The French government on Monday repeated that it would present its 1997 budget on September 18.
A number of international newspapers had erroneously reported that the budget would be presented on September 10.

Prime Minister Alain Juppe had said at the end of last month that he would present his tax reform plans around September 10, but then brought forward this announcement to September 5. The budget had always been due to be presented officially to the cabinet on September 18.

"The cabinet meeting to adopt the budget bill was always set for Wednesday September 18. And the announcement for the tax cut programme which had been planned for around September 10 was made on Thursday September 5," a government source said.
There will be no announcement on September 10.
